style_law: ONE graphics style through the entire game (Riley, 2026-11-23 16:30 CST): no region ships in its source generation's native look. Converted maps are data/layout deliverables; presentation restyles via this map at bind time.
presentation_status_for_all_maps: layout converted - presentation restyles via STYLE_MAP at bind time

johto_outdoor.bw2_replacement: BW2 town/route families: michi01/michi02 roads, grass01 grass, ki02/ki03 trees, hana01 flowers, kaidan01 stairs, town wall sets; building models from BW2 overworld grid chunks. Per-map-group roof graphics restyle from the same town wall/roof families (source roofs are dynamic loads, see conversion report)

johto_modern_outdoor.bw2_replacement: BW2 modern city families (c3/c8 city sets, michi01/michi02 roads) + city building chunks

kanto_gen2_outdoor.bw2_replacement: BW2 town/route families (same register as johto_outdoor)

forest.bw2_replacement: BW2 forest families (Pinwheel Forest texture sets + forest chunks)

park.bw2_replacement: BW2 park/garden families (Lostlorn Forest clearings, Castelia garden sets)

cave.bw2_replacement: BW2 cave/dungeon texture sets (d0/d6/d7/d29 families) + m_dun* dungeon chunks

ice_cave.bw2_replacement: BW2 ice-area families: Twist Mountain / Giant Chasm chunks and ice texture subsets of the dungeon sets (bind-time pick of the ice subset)

underground.bw2_replacement: BW2 ruins/cave sets (Relic Castle lower floors + d* families)

ruins.bw2_replacement: BW2 Relic Castle ruins families (masonry, floors, pillars)

unown_glyphs.bw2_replacement: Ruins masonry from the ruins family (meets floor); the glyph art itself has no BW2 source
unown_glyphs.floor_note: The Unown glyph wall art is unique to these rooms and exists nowhere in BW2. Needed: the glyph set redrawn at BW2 resolution (upscale/restyle from the source glyphs, which the conversion preserves as layout data). Flagged rather than mapped to a weak stand-in.

tower.bw2_replacement: BW2 tower interior families (Dragonspiral Tower / Celestial Tower chunks + in* sets)

lighthouse.bw2_replacement: BW2 tower interior families (same register as tower; BW2 has no lighthouse set of its own)

radio_tower.bw2_replacement: BW2 Pokestar Studios / broadcast interior sets (in* families) + studio chunks

battle_facility.bw2_replacement: BW2 PWT and Battle Subway interior chunks (m_* family) + in* sets

league.bw2_replacement: BW2 Pokemon League interior chunks + in* sets; pack 'plateau' tileset as 2D register

pokecenter.bw2_replacement: BW2 Pokemon Center interior sets (in* families); pack 'pokecenter' tileset as 2D register

mart.bw2_replacement: BW2 mart interior sets (in* families); pack 'mart' tileset as 2D register

house.bw2_replacement: BW2 house interior sets (in* families); pack 'house' tileset as 2D register

lab.bw2_replacement: BW2 lab interior sets (in* families); pack 'lab' tileset as 2D register. Map note: DragonShrine uses this source tileset but is a shrine -- its restyle takes the tower/ruins masonry register plus Dragonspiral Tower dragon-statue models

mansion.bw2_replacement: BW2 mansion interior sets (in* families); pack 'mansion' tileset as 2D register

game_corner.bw2_replacement: Room shell: BW2 lobby/Join Avenue interior sets (in* families)
game_corner.floor_note: The room shell meets the floor, but the family's identity is its slot machines and arcade props, for which BW2 has no source (BW2 has no Game Corner). Needed: original slot-machine/arcade prop models built at BW2 standard. Flagged rather than mapped to a weak stand-in.

gate.bw2_replacement: BW2 gate interior sets (in* families); pack 'gate' tileset as 2D register

port.bw2_replacement: BW2 harbor / Marine Tube interior families + dock chunks

train_station.bw2_replacement: BW2 station interior chunks (m_gstation* family) + in* sets
